metadata.name: Ecodesign for Solid
metadata.description: Ecodesign rules for Solid: fine-grained signals, narrow effects, lazy routes.

reactivite.name: Solid — reactivity
reactivite.description: Solid updates the exact node that changed, as long as the dependencies stay narrow (RGESN Frontend).

rules.title: Effect broader than its dependencies
rules.description: createEffect tracks everything it reads. Reading a whole store inside one makes the effect re-run for changes that do not concern it, which throws away the fine-grained updating that Solid exists for.
rules.recommendation: Read only the signals the effect needs, and use createMemo for a derived value several effects share. Verify that an update touches only the intended nodes.
rules.note: One createMemo, on() or untrack() anywhere in the file silences the rule. A narrow effect reading a single signal is exactly right, so what matters is what this one reads.
rules.source_note: Adapted from the Green Codex rule LANG-SOLID-003 (Institut du Numerique Responsable), whose rule content is published under CC BY 4.0. Reworded for this format; the patterns are specific to this audit.

rules.title: List rendered with map instead of For
rules.description: map recreates every row when the array changes, where the For component keeps the nodes whose item did not move. On a long list that is the difference between updating one row and rebuilding all of them.
rules.recommendation: Use For for keyed lists and Index when the position is what identifies the row.
rules.source_note: Adapted from the Green Codex rule LANG-SOLID-001 (Institut du Numerique Responsable), whose rule content is published under CC BY 4.0. Reworded for this format; the patterns are specific to this audit.
rules.note: This rule shares an extension with another framework's rule set, so it also stays silent in a file that imports the other framework: the pattern alone cannot tell which one is in play.
